peopleAlsoAsk.question: Is peptone the same as Bacto peptone?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: Yes, you can if the Peptone you have is for preparation of microbiological culture media. "Bacto" Peptone is just a commercial name for such Peptone (Bacto is the brand company commercialized by BD owning Difco).

peopleAlsoAsk.question: Why beta mercaptoethanol in cell culture media?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: 2-Mercaptoethanol, also known as beta-mercaptoethanol (BME), is a potent reducing agent used in cell culture medium to prevent toxic levels of oxygen radicals. 2-Mercaptoethanol is not stable in solution, thus protocols generally require daily supplementation.

peopleAlsoAsk.question: What is mem alpha?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: Minimum Essential Medium, Alpha Modification (Alpha MEM) contains additional amino acids and vitamins required for transfection of foreign DNA to mammalian cells. Minimum Essential Medium (MEM) was developed by Harry Eagle and has been used for a wide variety of cells grown in monolayer.
